Test: TC-2824 — Global - Task configuration - End Date mapped to Due Date in case the Start date is mapped to Original estimate
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-117 Global - Task configuration
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud, teamembers, teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2824 Global - Task configuration - End Date mapped to Due Date in case the Start date is mapped to Original estimate
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Column View is set to "TC2824". FolLowing tasks are visible on WBS and Gantt chart:
- TC-2824 Global - Task configuration - End Date mapped to Due Date in case the Start date is mapped to Original estimate (project task)
- TC-2824 Task 1
- TC-2824 Task 2
- TC-2824 Task 3
2. Grab the end of taskName and move it 2 days to the future. Refresh the page
   Data: taskName: TC-2824 Task 2
   Expected: Task is resized. The value of Original Estimate field in WBS is correctly updated to 3d. Due date is changed to 31/Dec/21.
3. Click on task key of taskName to open jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-2824 Task 3
   Expected: Jira issue view of TC-2824 Task 3 is opened in the new tab
4. Change Due date value to 31/Dec/21
   Expected: Due date is changed to 31/Dec/21
5. Go back to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2824 Global - Task configuration - End Date mapped to Due Date in case the Start date is mapped to Original estimate
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Task 3 is moved. Due date of TC-2824 Task 3 is set to 31/Dec/21. Start date is still on 29/Dec/21. The value of Original Estimate field is changed to 3d.
